closedByA82.title: No single fail-closed intake for fifty real audit cases
closedByA82.closure: A82 defines a fixed fifty-slot denominator with five balanced case classes and never prunes missing cases.

closedByA82.title: Contract address identity could be confused with verified source and bytecode
closedByA82.closure: Identity, deployed bytecode, source bundle, compiler settings and source-to-bytecode reproduction are separate mandatory receipts.

closedByA82.title: Known audit labels could be exposed before tool execution
closedByA82.closure: A82 requires blind-before-execution label receipts and independent post-run adjudication.

closedByA82.title: Fixture tool adapters could be credited as official execution
closedByA82.closure: Every official tool receipt binds executable SHA, version, configuration, target, input and raw output; fixtureOnly always receives zero real credit.

closedByA82.title: Source and deployed bytecode mismatch could still produce customer findings
closedByA82.closure: Any source-bytecode mismatch forces ABSTAIN and blocks all Pro/Advanced delivery.

closedByA82.title: False positives and false negatives lacked one complete real-case ledger
closedByA82.closure: A82 requires case, family, tier and evidence-bound FP/FN adjudication without dropping unavailable cases.

closedByA82.title: Remediated pairs were not bound to the original vulnerable identity
closedByA82.closure: Every remediation case requires exact predecessor, patch and post-deployment bindings.

closedByA82.title: Advanced could imply human review without a qualified signed reviewer
closedByA82.closure: Advanced remains blocked unless a qualified conflict-declared human review and independent sample are both present.

closedByA82.title: Tier value could be inflated by pages or duplicate findings
closedByA82.closure: Basic, Pro and Advanced require monotonic material fields, new evidence families and non-duplicate scenarios.

closedByA82.title: Public contract identities could be mistaken for rights-approved benchmark use
closedByA82.closure: Display, source, report, derived-data and redistribution rights are independent mandatory decisions.

closedByA82.title: Real-case denominators could be silently reduced to available tool outputs
closedByA82.closure: All fifty slots remain in the denominator as READY, BLOCKED, UNAVAILABLE or REJECTED_INTEGRITY.

closedByA82.title: A clean local harness could enable paid audit claims
closedByA82.closure: Local fixture success always records zero real cases, zero official tools, no customer accuracy, no paid readiness and sale disabled.

truthBoundary: A82 locally implements and adversarially verifies a fail-closed real-contract intake, official-tool evidence binding, blind-label, source-bytecode, tier-value and FP/FN ledger contract. The local run uses generated fixture cases only. The repository contains ten historical public identity seeds but zero complete rights-approved real cases, zero official tool executions, zero independent labels and zero paid-ready outputs.
